subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the open fork candidate for this Feishu reply-mention bug, ask for a fresh target-repo PR, or close that candidate and leave this issue as the tracker?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an exact open fork candidate still targets it and the earlier same-repo branch had proof and safety blockers, so duplicating repair work without a maintainer choice risks churn.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the fork PR as context but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Ask the fork author to refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and provide inspectable Feishu proof plus the safer mention/routing shape.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu channel bug and do not queue another repair lane until a maintainer can own it.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as context but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the most recent contributor in the exact Feishu mention detector and tests.
